news.title:
R R Kabel reports record Q4 revenue of ₹2,964.1 Cr, up 33.7% YoY.
FY26 revenue grew 27.6% YoY to ₹9,722.4 Cr; ₹9.50 dividend/share declared.
news.summary:
R R Kabel reports record Q4 revenue of ₹2,964.1 Cr, up 33.7% YoY.
FY26 revenue grew 27.6% YoY to ₹9,722.4 Cr; ₹9.50 dividend/share declared.

news.title:
RR Kabel targets breakeven in electrical goods with capacity expansion.
The company plans this growth through increased capital expenditure.
news.summary:
RR Kabel targets breakeven in electrical goods with capacity expansion.
The company plans this growth through increased capital expenditure.

news.title:
HSBC maintains Buy on RR Kabel with ₹1,770 target, citing strong Wire & Cable growth.
Demand, commodity tailwinds, and FMEG turnaround support ~21% EPS CAGR over FY26-29.
news.summary:
HSBC maintains Buy on RR Kabel with ₹1,770 target, citing strong Wire & Cable growth.
Demand, commodity tailwinds, and FMEG turnaround support ~21% EPS CAGR over FY26-29.

news.title:
RR Kabel projects 18% CAGR in Wires & Cables, 25% in FMEG over 3 years.
The company plans Rs.1,200 crore CAPEX to support its growth projections.
news.summary:
RR Kabel projects 18% CAGR in Wires & Cables, 25% in FMEG over 3 years.
The company plans Rs.1,200 crore CAPEX to support its growth projections.

news.title:
RR Kabel's Q4 revenue surged 33.6% to ₹2,964 crore, net profit rose 30.2% to ₹168 crore.
Despite robust sales and W&C growth, flat margins led RR Kabel's stock to fall 5% on NSE.
news.summary:
RR Kabel's Q4 revenue surged 33.6% to ₹2,964 crore, net profit rose 30.2% to ₹168 crore.
Despite robust sales and W&C growth, flat margins led RR Kabel's stock to fall 5% on NSE.

news.title:
R R Kabel sets record date as 16 June 2026 for Rs. 5.5/share dividend.
Dividend equals 110% of face value; payment awaits shareholder approval.
news.summary:
R R Kabel sets record date as 16 June 2026 for Rs. 5.5/share dividend.

news.title:
R R Kabel Ltd reported its highest-ever revenue in Q4 FY26, up 33.7% YoY.
EBITDA grew 34.6%, PAT rose 30.1%, with wires & cables revenue up 36.3%.
news.summary:
R R Kabel Ltd reported its highest-ever revenue in Q4 FY26, up 33.7% YoY.
EBITDA grew 34.6%, PAT rose 30.1%, with wires & cables revenue up 36.3%.

news.title:
R R Kabel's board approved FY26 audited results; final dividend at Rs. 5.5/share.
Interim dividend of Rs. 4/share was paid; Rs. 19.0 cr liability from new labour codes.
news.summary:
R R Kabel's board approved FY26 audited results; final dividend at Rs. 5.5/share.
Interim dividend of Rs. 4/share was paid; Rs. 19.0 cr liability from new labour codes.

news.title:
R R Kabel's Q4 EBITDA rose to ₹2.62B from ₹1.9B YoY, up 38%.
EBITDA margin improved marginally to 8.83% from 8.76% YoY.
news.summary:
R R Kabel's Q4 EBITDA rose to ₹2.62B from ₹1.9B YoY, up 38%.
EBITDA margin improved marginally to 8.83% from 8.76% YoY.

news.title:
GST department appeals against R R Kabel's refund orders of ₹36.9 cr, ₹31.7 cr.
Company anticipates no significant financial impact from these appeals.
news.summary:
GST department appeals against R R Kabel's refund orders of ₹36.9 cr, ₹31.7 cr.

news.title:
R R Kabel received reassessment order for AY 2022-23 with IT demand of ₹9.01 Cr.
The company plans to appeal and expects no major operational impact.
news.summary:

Tax demand totals ₹12.7 Cr; company plans to appeal, expects negligible impact.

news.title:
R R Kabel posts 42.3% YoY revenue growth in Q3 FY26 to INR 2536 Cr.
9M revenue hits INR 6758 Cr (+25.1% YoY); EBITDA up 86% with margin gains.
news.summary:
R R Kabel posts 42.3% YoY revenue growth in Q3 FY26 to INR 2536 Cr.

news.title: RR Kabel anticipates a 100 bps annual margin rise, driven by exports.
news.summary: RR Kabel anticipates a 100 bps annual margin rise, driven by exports.

news.title:
RR Kabel benefits from growth in wires and cables driven by electrification and clean energy.
Manufacturers are expanding in residential wiring, industrial conductors, and power cables.
news.summary:

news.title:
R R Kabel's Q3 FY26 revenue rose 42.3% YoY to ₹2,535.9 Cr; EBITDA grew 86% YoY.
PAT up 72.4% YoY to ₹118.2 Cr; demand in Wires & Cables strong, FMEG losses reduced.
news.summary:

The company plans to appeal against the penalty imposed under CGST and IGST Acts.

Meetings include Nuvama, Axis Capital, Kotak, and Investec events; no UPSI will be shared.

news.title:
US tariffs have hurt Indian cable and telecom firms like Sterlite Tech, HFCL, Polycab, Havells, and RR Kabel, impacting margins and exports amid a US data centre boom.
Companies aim to mitigate tariffs by localizing production or diversifying markets; demand remains strong in the US for data centres and broadband infrastructure.

Companies aim to mitigate tariffs by localizing production or diversifying markets; demand remains strong in the US for data centres and broadband infrastructure.
